name: BEND PARKS AND REC DIST OFF

fr.elements: Main Building; Open Green Space; Open Green Space; Walkway; Walkway; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Road; Landscaped Area; Water Feature
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Single Access Point
fr.recommendations:
• Mark all access points with visible address numbers or building identifiers so responders can quickly confirm entry locations.

• Mark the single rear access point with reflective signage to distinguish it from non-access areas.

• Trim dense vegetation along walkways and access roads to maintain clear sightlines for approaching responders.

• Keep the vehicle parking areas clear of overflow parking that could block emergency vehicle movement.

• Keep the access road clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris at all times.

• Trim vegetation around the water feature if it obstructs responder movement or visibility along adjacent walkways.

• Post signage at the primary access road identifying which access points lead to the rear of the building.

wildfire.conditions: Open Green Space; Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Building; Large Paved Area; Mixed Vegetation; Scattered Shrubs; Water Feature; Vegetation Near Access Route; Open Terrain; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim trees and shrubs that are growing close to building edges where vegetation contacts or nearly contacts the structure.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material from shrub beds located immediately adjacent to buildings.
• Keep the vegetation along the access route trimmed back so it does not narrow the driveway or obstruct vehicle movement.
• Thin the tree cluster to reduce the concentration of branches and foliage that could carry fire toward nearby buildings.
• Keep the large paved area free of vegetation growing through cracks or along edges nearest to structures.
• Maintain the open areas between tree groupings and buildings by preventing shrubs or low vegetation from filling in those gaps.
